methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper will be reviewed the state of the art of implementation of this standard, benefits, and challenges based on literature studies

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Descriptive-analytic literature review of ISO 50001 implementation, benefits and challenges. Energy performance indicators/baselines are mentioned only incidentally (ISO 50001:2018 concept refinements) and the case-study 'energy performance improvement' percentages are reported as CEM-award outcomes; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach).

paper_type.evidence_quote: The method used in this review is descriptive-analytic based on literature studies from several scientific journals

stage1.notes: Award-profile energy performance improvement percentages (e.g. 3.76%) are reported as outcomes, not characterised EnPI/EnB models; petrochemical/ammonia/steel firms appear only as case examples.
